ideas: A recent big purchase you made
The steps you take before deciding
A past mistake that changed your approach

phrases.phrase: weigh up the pros and cons

model: I'd like to talk about how I decided to buy a new laptop last spring, because it's a good example of how I handle big purchases now. I used to be quite careless with money. A few years ago I bought an expensive phone as an impulse buy, and it turned out the battery was terrible. Due to that experience, I've become much more careful, which means that I now follow a kind of routine. First, I set a budget. For the laptop, I decided I wouldn't spend more than twenty million dong, and that stopped me from being tempted by fancy models. Then I read reviews online and watched a few comparison videos, because I wanted real value for money rather than a famous brand name. After that, I shopped around. I checked three different shops and two websites, and the prices varied a lot, so it definitely paid off. Finally, I like to sleep on it. Waiting one night usually results in a calmer decision, and I weigh up the pros and cons properly instead of just feeling excited. In the end, I chose a mid-range laptop that's light enough to carry to work every day. As a consequence of this careful approach, I've been really happy with it, and I don't regret spending the money. I still splash out on things occasionally, but only when I've thought it through.
